title: Armorheart
summary: Four tank missions: open an evacuation route, confront a giant gorilla, intercept a battleship and defeat a fortress. Earn a collection of four cosmetic tanks.
summaryZhTW: 四個戰車任務：打通撤離路線、迎戰巨獸、攔截戰艦、攻克砲壘。首次完成不同任務可逐步收藏四款戰車外觀。
controls: Arrows/WASD move and face; hold Space to fire. Touch supports simultaneous direction and Fire. Pause, retry, mute, reduced motion and live language switching.
limitations: Progress is local to this browser/device. All four tank designs are cosmetic and share identical mechanics. Short landscape screens scroll. Physical-phone, independent first-time-player, other-engine and human assistive-technology tests remain unperformed; full nonvisual Canvas support is incomplete. Accepted fast-win strategies and tank/transport overlap remain. Asset provenance qualifications are retained in the source release preflight.

approval.note: Owner accepted integrated RC1 and separately authorized game and Games catalog publication. Manual game run41950065569 published the exact reviewed executable. Independent public identity, keyboard/touch wins, unlocks, bilingual switching and persistence passed; no broader human/hardware certification is implied.
